subject: DI04005021

body.en:
Definition / principle

Leaching removes a soluble constituent from a solid by contact with a liquid solvent. The remaining solid carrier is substantially insoluble under the chosen conditions.

Detailed theory and conditions

Solvent reaches the solute, dissolution occurs and dissolved material moves from internal pores to the bulk liquid. Examples include oil extraction from vegetable seeds, sugar recovery from prepared plant material and suitable hydrometallurgical recovery. The liquid product is leach liquor; in oil extraction it is often called miscella. Residual solids may retain valuable solution and therefore need washing. Leaching is different from liquid–liquid extraction because the feed contains an insoluble solid framework. Rate can be limited by access, dissolution, internal diffusion or external film transfer; not every delay is solved by stronger agitation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Liquid solvent વડે solid માંનો soluble constituent દૂર કરવો એટલે leaching. Chosen conditions પર બાકી solid carrier substantially insoluble રહે છે.

વિગતવાર Theory તથા Conditions

Solvent solute સુધી પહોંચે છે, dissolution થાય છે અને dissolved material internal pores માંથી bulk liquid માં આવે છે. Vegetable seeds માંથી oil, prepared plant material માંથી sugar તથા suitable hydrometallurgical recovery examples છે. Liquid product leach liquor તથા oil extraction માં miscella કહેવાય છે. Residual solids solution retain કરતાં હોવાથી washing જરૂરી છે. LLE કરતાં ફરક insoluble solid framework છે. Access, dissolution, internal diffusion અથવા external film rate limit કરી શકે છે; દરેક delay નું solution વધારે agitation નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Solid preparation modifies size, structure and accessibility so solvent can contact the soluble material effectively.

Detailed theory and conditions

Crushing or grinding increases exposed area and shortens internal diffusion paths; seed flaking opens cells while retaining useful permeability. Screening can remove excessive fines and produce a more uniform bed. Appropriate pretreatment may release trapped solute, but it must not destroy the desired product or generate unwanted soluble impurities. Excessively fine material can compact, block percolation, make filtration difficult and increase entrainment. Choose particle size according to the contactor: an agitated slurry tolerates a different size distribution from a heap or fixed-bed percolator. Preparation also includes representative feed sampling and documenting initial solute/moisture when a recovery balance is required.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Solvent soluble material ને effectively contact કરી શકે તે માટે size, structure તથા accessibility બદલવી એટલે solid preparation.

વિગતવાર Theory તથા Conditions

Crushing/grinding થી exposed area વધે તથા internal diffusion path ઘટે છે. Seed flaking cells ખોલીને useful permeability જાળવે છે. Screening excessive fines દૂર કરીને uniform bed આપે છે. Pretreatment trapped solute release કરી શકે છે, પણ desired product ન બગડે તથા unwanted soluble impurities ન બને. Excessive fines compaction, blocked percolation, difficult filtration તથા entrainment કરે છે. Heap/fixed bed અને agitated slurry માટે particle-size distribution જુદી પસંદ થાય છે. Recovery balance માટે feed sampling તથા initial solute/moisture નોંધો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Leaching temperature is a selected operating condition affecting solubility, diffusion, viscosity and product/solvent stability.

Detailed theory and conditions

Higher temperature often increases dissolution rate and diffusivity and reduces liquid viscosity, but solubility does not universally rise with temperature. Consider actual solubility data, heat sensitivity, undesired reactions, corrosion, solvent vapor pressure and energy cost. Boiling or evaporation changes solvent inventory and can invalidate a simple material balance. Volatile/flammable solvents require the approved closed system and temperature controls; an educational diagram does not authorize heating or pressurization. Select a temperature giving sufficient rate and recovery without degrading the product or exceeding equipment limits.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Solubility, diffusion, viscosity તથા product/solvent stability ને અસર કરતી selected operating condition leaching temperature છે.

વિગતવાર Theory તથા Conditions

Temperature વધતાં dissolution rate/diffusivity ઘણીવાર વધે તથા viscosity ઘટે છે, પણ solubility હંમેશાં વધતી નથી. Actual solubility, heat sensitivity, unwanted reactions, corrosion, vapor pressure તથા energy જુઓ. Evaporation solvent inventory બદલી balance invalid કરી શકે છે. Volatile/flammable solvent માટે approved closed system/controls જોઈએ. Study diagram heating/pressurization ની permission નથી. Product તથા equipment limits જાળવી પૂરતો rate/recovery આપતું temperature પસંદ કરો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Unsteady leaching changes a batch or bed inventory/composition with time. Steady continuous leaching has approximately constant stream conditions without time accumulation in the chosen control volume.

Detailed theory and conditions

Unsteady operations in the syllabus are in-place, heap, Shanks-system and closed-vessel percolation. Steady operations include leaching during grinding, Dorr agitation, continuous countercurrent decantation, Rotocel and Bollman extraction. A fixed heap can deliver liquor continuously while the solid bed is still being depleted unsteadily; continuous liquid withdrawal alone does not prove steady solids operation. The PDF wording “Door Agitator” is interpreted as the standard Dorr agitator. The individual construction/working cards follow this classification.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Unsteady leaching માં batch/bed inventory-composition time સાથે બદલાય છે. Steady continuous leaching માં selected control volume ના stream conditions આશરે constant તથા time accumulation zero છે.

વિગતવાર Theory તથા Conditions

Syllabus ના unsteady operations in-place, heap, Shanks તથા closed-vessel percolation છે. Steady operations leaching during grinding, Dorr agitation, CCD, Rotocel તથા Bollman છે. Fixed heap માં liquor continuously નીકળે છતાં solid bed time સાથે deplete થઈ unsteady હોઈ શકે છે. ફક્ત continuous liquid outlet થી steady solids operation સાબિત થતું નથી. PDF નું “Door Agitator” standard Dorr agitator તરીકે સમજ્યું છે. નીચે classification મુજબ Construction/Working cards છે.

body.en:
Definition

Removal of soluble material from a permeable deposit without first excavating the entire solid mass.

Principle

A compatible leach liquid percolates through the deposit and dissolves accessible solute for controlled collection.

Construction

The system uses an accessible permeable solid body, engineered liquid-distribution or injection points and a collection/recovery system. Monitoring and containment measures must suit the site hydrogeology and environmental permit. The schematic shows supply, flow through the deposit and collected liquor; it is not a design for an unconfined release or a drilling/injection procedure. Site characterization is essential before feasibility can be established.

Working

Leach liquid enters the prepared flow paths and contacts the solute-bearing material. Dissolved material is carried toward the recovery points, while the insoluble framework largely remains in place. Liquor is collected for further recovery and may be conditioned for reuse. As readily accessible solute is depleted, the rate changes and bypassed zones can remain unextracted. The process is therefore an unsteady depletion of a heterogeneous deposit, even when pumps deliver a nearly constant flow.

Applications

Selected permeable deposits with demonstrated chemistry, hydraulic control and regulatory approval.

Limitations and precautions

Permeability, channeling, poor recovery control and groundwater/environmental risk can make it unsuitable.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

સંપૂર્ણ solid mass excavate કર્યા વગર permeable deposit માંથી soluble material દૂર કરવાની operation છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Compatible leach liquid deposit માંથી percolate થઈ accessible solute dissolve કરે છે અને controlled collection થાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

System માં accessible permeable solid body, engineered distribution/injection points તથા collection/recovery system છે. Monitoring/containment site hydrogeology તથા environmental permit મુજબ જોઈએ. Sketch supply, deposit flow તથા collected liquor બતાવે છે; unconfined release અથવા drilling/injection procedure નથી. Site characterization વગર feasibility નક્કી ન થાય.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Leach liquid prepared paths માંથી solute-bearing material ને contact કરે છે. Dissolved material recovery points તરફ જાય છે અને insoluble framework સ્થાને રહે છે. Liquor further recovery માટે collect થાય છે અને reuse માટે condition થઈ શકે છે. Solute deplete થતાં rate બદલાય છે તથા bypassed zones unextracted રહી શકે છે. Pump flow constant હોય છતાં deposit depletion unsteady છે.

ઉપયોગો

Proven chemistry, hydraulic control તથા approval ધરાવતા selected permeable deposits.

Limitations તથા Precautions

Permeability, channeling, poor recovery control તથા groundwater/environmental risk limits છે.

body.en:
Definition

Leaching a prepared pile of solid on an engineered collection pad by distributed solvent percolation.

Principle

Liquid flows through voids, dissolves solute and drains as enriched liquor.

Construction

Prepared particles form a heap on a suitably lined, sloped pad with drainage collection. A distribution network wets the upper surface and drains direct liquor to a controlled collection tank. The system includes solution management and containment rather than allowing free seepage into soil. Particle size and heap construction must preserve permeability; the drawing represents a process arrangement, not geotechnical or liner specifications.

Working

Distributed liquid trickles through the heap and dissolves accessible material as it moves downward. The enriched drainage is collected and sent to recovery or controlled recirculation. Leaching slows as solute becomes less accessible and local channels can leave dry regions or bypass solids. The solid heap is depleted with time, so this is unsteady operation despite ongoing liquid feed and collection. Excessive fines or compaction restrict flow and reduce effective contact.

Applications

Large prepared solid masses where slower percolation recovery is acceptable.

Limitations and precautions

Long residence time, weather, channeling and environmental containment are important limitations.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Engineered collection pad પર prepared solid pile માં distributed solvent percolation થી leaching કરવું.

સિદ્ધાંત

Void spaces માંથી liquid પસાર થઈ solute dissolve કરે છે અને enriched liquor drain થાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

Prepared particles lined/sloped pad પર heap બનાવે છે. Surface distribution network તથા drainage collection liquor ને controlled tank તરફ લઈ જાય છે. Solution management/containment જમીનમાં free seepage રોકે છે. Particle size તથા heap arrangement permeability જાળવે છે. Drawing process arrangement છે; liner/geotechnical specification નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Distributed liquid heap માંથી નીચે trickle થઈ accessible solute dissolve કરે છે. Enriched drainage recovery/controlled recirculation માટે collect થાય છે. Solute accessibility ઘટતાં rate ઘટે છે. Channeling dry/bypassed zones બનાવી શકે છે. Continuous liquid feed છતાં heap time સાથે deplete થવાથી unsteady છે. Fines/compaction flow તથા effective contact ઘટાડે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Slower percolation recovery સ્વીકાર્ય હોય તેવા large prepared solid masses.

Limitations તથા Precautions

Long residence time, weather, channeling તથા containment મહત્વનાં limits છે.

body.en:
Definition

A valve-switched battery of batch leaching vessels arranged to approximate countercurrent washing.

Principle

Fresh solvent contacts the most exhausted solids; progressively richer liquor contacts progressively fresher solids.

Construction

Several vessels hold separate solid charges on suitable supports. Connecting pipes, valves, liquid-distribution and drain arrangements allow a chosen order of percolation and isolation of one vessel for discharge/recharging. A final liquor receiver and fresh-solvent supply complete the battery. The roles “fresh,”“intermediate” and “nearly spent” shift cyclically among physical vessels rather than identifying permanently fixed tanks.

Working

Fresh solvent is passed first through the nearly spent charge, then through less depleted charges and finally the fresh material, from which strong liquor is withdrawn. When the oldest charge is sufficiently exhausted, it is isolated, drained, emptied and replaced under the approved procedure. The valve order is then advanced so the newly loaded charge becomes the fresh end of the sequence. Solids do not flow continuously through the pipes; countercurrent behavior is obtained by cyclic switching of batch duties.

Applications

Battery percolation and staged batch washing of suitable solids.

Limitations and precautions

Valve sequencing, dead volume, solid retention and incomplete draining affect recovery; never switch a pressurized hazardous system from a study sketch.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Countercurrent washing approximate કરવા valve-switched batch leaching vessels ની battery છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Fresh solvent સૌથી exhausted solids ને અને progressively rich liquor progressively fresh solids ને contact કરે છે.

રચના (Construction)

ઘણા vessels supports પર separate solid charges રાખે છે. Pipes/valves/distribution/drains થી percolation order બદલાય છે તથા એક vessel isolate કરીને discharge/recharge થાય છે. Fresh-solvent supply તથા rich-liquor receiver battery પૂર્ણ કરે છે. Fresh/intermediate/nearly-spent roles physical tanks વચ્ચે cyclically shift થાય છે; permanent labels નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Fresh solvent પહેલાં nearly-spent charge, પછી less-depleted charges અને અંતે fresh material માંથી જાય છે. Fresh end પરથી strong liquor મળે છે. Oldest charge exhausted થાય ત્યારે approved procedure મુજબ isolate/drain/discharge/recharge થાય છે. Valve order advance કરીને newly loaded charge fresh end બને છે. Solids pipes માં continuously વહેતા નથી; batch duties cyclically switch કરતાં countercurrent behavior મળે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Suitable solids નું battery percolation તથા staged batch washing.

Limitations તથા Precautions

Valve sequence, dead volume, solid retention તથા draining recovery બદલે છે. Study sketch પરથી hazardous pressurized system switch ન કરો.

body.en:
Definition

Batch solid-bed leaching in an enclosed vessel allowing controlled liquid distribution and liquor collection.

Principle

Solvent passes through a stationary permeable bed and carries dissolved solute through the support/drain.

Construction

The enclosed vessel has a charging/discharging arrangement, perforated false bottom or screen, a liquid distributor, solvent inlet and filtered-liquor drain. Pressure/temperature instruments, vents and protective systems depend on the rated design. A receiver collects liquor without losing solid particles. The bed support preserves flow passages; it is not an absolute filter for every fine particle or a guarantee against plugging.

Working

A solid charge is contacted by distributed solvent that moves through its voids. Dissolved solute leaves with percolate while the bed remains supported inside the vessel. Fresh solvent or staged washes can reduce retained solute before draining and removal of the spent solids. Composition changes during the batch, so the duty is unsteady. Enclosure can improve containment and permit design-rated conditions, but pressure alone does not remove internal diffusion resistance or ensure complete extraction.

Applications

Contained batch percolation of suitable prepared solids.

Limitations and precautions

Plugging, channeling, fines and trapped solvent require proper design and safe isolation; no improvised pressure operation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Controlled liquid distribution તથા collection માટે enclosed vessel માં batch solid-bed leaching.

સિદ્ધાંત

Solvent stationary permeable bed માંથી પસાર થઈ dissolved solute support/drain મારફતે લઈ જાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

Enclosed vessel માં charging/discharging arrangement, false bottom/screen, liquid distributor, solvent inlet તથા liquor drain છે. Rated design મુજબ pressure/temperature instruments, vents તથા protection હોય છે. Receiver solids વગર liquor collect કરે છે. Support flow passages જાળવે છે; દરેક fine particle માટે absolute filter અથવા plugging સામે guarantee નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Solid charge ના voids માં distributed solvent પસાર થાય છે. Dissolved solute percolate સાથે નીકળે છે અને bed support પર રહે છે. Fresh solvent/staged washes retained solute ઘટાડે છે; પછી drain તથા spent-solid removal થાય છે. Batch દરમિયાન composition બદલાય એટલે unsteady છે. Enclosure containment/approved conditions માટે મદદ કરે છે, પણ pressure પોતે internal diffusion resistance દૂર કરતું નથી અથવા complete extraction આપતું નથી.

ઉપયોગો

Suitable prepared solids નું contained batch percolation.

Limitations તથા Precautions

Plugging, channeling, fines તથા trapped solvent માટે proper design/isolation જરૂરી છે. Improvised pressure operation નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Simultaneous wet size reduction and dissolution of accessible solute in a suitable grinding contactor.

Principle

Grinding exposes fresh surfaces and shortens diffusion paths while liquid removes dissolved material.

Construction

A representative wet mill includes a robust shell, grinding media or a suitable comminution mechanism, solid/solvent feeds and a slurry discharge. A classifier or downstream separator may return coarse material and separate liquid from solids. The unit is selected for the material and solvent compatibility; an ordinary dry mill cannot be assumed suitable for volatile liquids or reactive slurries.

Working

Solid and liquid are fed continuously under the selected wet-grinding conditions. As particles break, the solvent contacts newly exposed solute and dissolution proceeds during residence in the mill. The slurry leaves for classification, further contact or separation; the mill itself does not necessarily produce a clear liquor and washed solid. The balance between improved access and excessive fines must be controlled because fine material may complicate downstream settling and filtration.

Applications

Selected mineral/process slurries where comminution and extraction can be combined.

Limitations and precautions

Wear, power, fines, contamination and solvent safety limit applicability.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Suitable grinding contactor માં wet size reduction સાથે accessible solute નું dissolution કરવું.

સિદ્ધાંત

Grinding fresh surfaces expose કરે છે તથા diffusion paths ઘટાડે છે; liquid dissolved material દૂર કરે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Representative wet mill માં robust shell, grinding media/compatible comminution mechanism, solid/solvent feeds તથા slurry discharge છે. Classifier/downstream separator coarse return તથા solid–liquid separation કરી શકે છે. Material/solvent compatibility પ્રમાણે unit પસંદ થાય છે. Ordinary dry mill volatile liquid/reactive slurry માટે suitable માનવો નહીં.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Solid તથા liquid selected wet-grinding conditions પર continuously feed થાય છે. Particles તૂટતાં solvent નવા exposed solute ને contact કરે છે અને residence દરમિયાન dissolution થાય છે. Slurry classification, further contact અથવા separation માટે જાય છે. Mill પોતે clear liquor તથા washed solids આપશે જ નહીં. Access સુધારવા સાથે excessive fines નિયંત્રિત કરો; fines downstream settling/filtering મુશ્કેલ કરે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Comminution/extraction combine થઈ શકે તેવા selected mineral/process slurries.

Limitations તથા Precautions

Wear, power, fines, contamination તથા solvent safety limits છે.

body.en:
Definition

A slurry-leaching agitator combining mechanical rake action with circulation associated with an air-lift arrangement in the classical form.

Principle

Circulation and suspension improve solvent–solid contact and reduce external film limitations without replacing adequate dissolution time.

Construction

The tank contains a central driven shaft/air-lift region, slow moving rake arms near the bottom and suitable slurry inlet/outlet connections. The classical mechanism uses air-assisted central lifting with outward/downward circulation and bottom sweeping to return solids to contact. This is not merely a tall conical Pachuca air-lift vessel; the Dorr arrangement includes mechanical rake action. The exact drive and air paths depend on the manufacturer.

Working

Slow rakes move settled pulp toward the central hollow shaft, where an air stream lifts it; top distribution returns slurry to the tank. Slurry and solvent remain in contact during this circulation. Dissolved solute passes into the liquid as particles circulate through the vessel. At approximately steady throughput, a contacted slurry leaves for further reaction/leaching or solid–liquid separation. The agitator does not by itself guarantee a clear extract or full equilibrium; settlers/filters may be needed afterward. The supplied PDF’s “Door” is read as Dorr, not a separate door-operated machine.

Applications

Agitated leaching of suitable mineral/process slurries.

Limitations and precautions

Air compatibility, abrasion, foaming, suspension and drive maintenance matter; air addition is not suitable for every solvent.

Reference: [3] Dorr hollow-shaft/rake mechanism description.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Classical form માં mechanical rake તથા air-lift circulation જોડતો slurry-leaching agitator છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Circulation/suspension solvent–solid contact સુધારે છે તથા external film resistance ઘટાડે છે; પૂરતો dissolution time હજુ જોઈએ.

રચના (Construction)

Tank માં central driven shaft/air-lift region, bottom નજીક slow rake arms તથા slurry inlet/outlet છે. Classical air-assisted central lift થી outward/downward circulation તથા bottom sweeping થાય છે. આ ફક્ત tall conical Pachuca air-lift vessel નથી; Dorr માં mechanical rake action છે. Exact drive/air paths manufacturer-dependent છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Slow rakes settled pulp ને central hollow shaft તરફ લાવે છે. Air stream તેને ઉપર lift કરે છે અને top distribution slurry tank માં પાછી આપે છે. Slurry/solvent contact દરમિયાન solute liquid માં જાય છે. Approximately steady throughput પર contacted slurry further leaching અથવા solid–liquid separation માટે નીકળે છે. Agitator clear extract/full equilibrium ની guarantee નથી; પછી settler/filter જોઈએ. PDF નું “Door” Dorr તરીકે લીધું છે, અલગ door-operated machine નથી.

ઉપયોગો

Suitable mineral/process slurries નું agitated leaching.

Limitations તથા Precautions

Air compatibility, abrasion, foaming, suspension તથા drive maintenance મહત્વનાં છે. દરેક solvent માટે air addition suitable નથી.

Reference: [3] Dorr hollow-shaft/rake mechanism description.

body.en:
Definition

A series of thickeners/wash stages moving solid-rich underflow forward while wash liquor progresses oppositely.

Principle

Repeated dilution, mixing and gravity separation wash soluble material from retained solution with countercurrent use of fresh liquid.

Construction

Several gravity thickeners have feed wells, rake mechanisms, clear-overflow launders and controlled underflow outlets. Transfer lines send each underflow to the next stage and overflow toward the preceding stage. Fresh wash enters the final solids stage; rich liquor leaves the first. The schematic separates the two flow directions and labels underflow as solids plus retained solution, not dry solid alone.

Working

Slurry enters the first stage and mixes with liquor from the next stage. Solids settle and move onward as underflow, while clarified liquid flows backward as overflow. The final stage receives fresh wash, so progressively cleaner liquid meets progressively more depleted solids. Rich overflow is recovered at the feed end and washed solids leave at the opposite end. Carryover, settling capacity and the amount of retained solution determine the washing performance; ideal stage contact is an approximation.

Applications

Countercurrent washing/recovery from settleable leached slurries.

Limitations and precautions

Poor settling, fine solids, entrainment and large retained-liquid inventory limit performance.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Thickeners/wash stages ની series જેમાં solid-rich underflow આગળ તથા wash liquor opposite direction માં જાય છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Repeated dilution, mixing તથા gravity separation થી retained solution નું soluble material countercurrent fresh wash વડે recover થાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

દરેક gravity thickener માં feed well, rake, clear-overflow launder તથા underflow outlet છે. Transfer lines underflow ને next stage અને overflow ને previous stage લઈ જાય છે. Fresh wash final solids stage માં enter થાય છે; rich liquor first stage પરથી નીકળે છે. Sketch underflow ને solids+retained solution તરીકે બતાવે છે, dry solid નહીં.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Slurry first stage માં next-stage liquor સાથે mix થાય છે. Settled solids underflow બની આગળ તથા clear overflow પાછળ જાય છે. Final stage માં fresh wash આવતા progressively cleaner liquid progressively depleted solids ને મળે છે. Feed end પરથી rich liquor તથા opposite end પરથી washed solids મળે છે. Carryover, settling capacity તથા retained solution wash performance નક્કી કરે છે. Ideal stage contact approximation છે.

ઉપયોગો

Settleable leached slurries નું countercurrent washing/recovery.

Limitations તથા Precautions

Poor settling, fines, entrainment તથા મોટી retained-liquid inventory limits છે.

body.en:
Definition

A continuous vegetable-seed extractor using slowly rotating compartments over a drainage arrangement.

Principle

Solvent percolation and staged miscella reuse contact prepared seeds in an approximately countercurrent progression.

Construction

A closed housing contains a rotating compartmented carousel, a perforated drainage floor/sections, feed and spent-meal discharge stations, and several spray/collection zones. Pumps route collected miscella to appropriate upstream spray zones. Fresh solvent is supplied near the nearly extracted meal end; strong miscella is collected near the fresh-feed end. The discharge arrangement releases meal from a compartment before it returns to charging.

Working

Prepared permeable flakes enter a compartment and move through successive spray zones as the carousel rotates. Liquid percolates through the solids and drains into segregated collectors, then is reused in a sequence that increases concentration toward fresh feed. The most depleted material receives the freshest solvent before drainage and discharge. Extracted meal proceeds to a separate enclosed solvent-recovery/desolventizing system rather than open heating. The stationary collection/spray arrangement and rotating solids provide continuous production with changing conditions within each compartment.

Applications

Continuous oil extraction from properly prepared vegetable seeds.

Limitations and precautions

Bed permeability, fines, uniform sprays, sealing and flammable-solvent containment are critical.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Drainage arrangement ઉપર slowly rotating compartments ધરાવતો continuous vegetable-seed extractor છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Solvent percolation તથા staged miscella reuse થી prepared seeds સાથે approximately countercurrent progression બને છે.

રચના (Construction)

Closed housing માં rotating compartmented carousel, perforated drainage floor/sections, feed/meal discharge stations તથા spray/collection zones છે. Pumps miscella ને યોગ્ય upstream sprays તરફ મોકલે છે. Nearly-extracted meal end પાસે fresh solvent તથા fresh-feed end પાસે strong miscella collection થાય છે. Compartment charging પાસે પાછું આવે તે પહેલાં meal discharge થાય છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Permeable flakes compartment માં ભરી rotation સાથે successive spray zones માં જાય છે. Liquid percolate/drain થઈ segregated collectors માં મળે છે અને fresh feed તરફ concentration વધે તેવી sequence માં reuse થાય છે. Most depleted material ને freshest solvent મળે છે; પછી drain/discharge થાય છે. Meal separate enclosed solvent-recovery/desolventizing system માં જાય છે, open heating નહીં. Rotating solids તથા stationary sprays/collectors continuous production આપે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Properly prepared vegetable seeds માંથી continuous oil extraction.

Limitations તથા Precautions

Bed permeability, fines, uniform sprays, sealing તથા flammable-solvent containment critical છે.

body.en:
Definition

A continuous vertical extractor carrying prepared solids in perforated buckets on an endless chain.

Principle

Two bucket runs combine contact with recycled miscella and fresh solvent, including a countercurrent washing run.

Construction

An enclosed vertical housing contains an endless bucket conveyor with descending and ascending runs, top loading/discharge stations and segregated liquid collectors. Fresh-solvent distributors wet the upper ascending run; partially enriched miscella from that side is pumped to the top descending run. Rich miscella is collected beneath the descending side. Perforated buckets retain solids while allowing liquid drainage through the load.

Working

Fresh flakes are loaded into descending buckets and meet recycled, partially enriched miscella flowing downward with them: that section is co-current. The partly extracted solids then ascend on the other run while fresh solvent percolates downward, forming the countercurrent final-wash section. The intermediate liquor is reused on fresh material and the richest miscella leaves the descending-side collector. Exhausted meal is discharged near the top of the ascending run into enclosed solvent recovery. The whole machine must not be described as purely countercurrent because its two runs differ.

Applications

Continuous solvent extraction of suitably prepared vegetable-seed material.

Limitations and precautions

Bucket drainage, chain maintenance, fines, liquid segregation and solvent containment govern operation.

Reference: [2] Bollman partially countercurrent bucket arrangement.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Endless chain ના perforated buckets માં prepared solids લઈ જતો continuous vertical extractor છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

બે bucket runs recycled miscella તથા fresh solvent contact આપે છે; એક run countercurrent washing કરે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Enclosed vertical housing માં descending/ascending bucket runs, top loading/discharge તથા segregated collectors છે. Upper ascending run પર fresh solvent આવે છે. તે side નો partially rich miscella pump થી top descending run પર જાય છે. Descending side નીચે rich miscella collect થાય છે. Perforated buckets solids retain કરીને liquid drain કરે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Fresh flakes descending buckets માં ભરાય છે અને recycled partial miscella પણ નીચે જાય છે; આ section co-current છે. Partly extracted solids બીજી run પર ઉપર જાય છે જ્યારે fresh solvent નીચે percolate થાય છે; આ countercurrent final-wash section છે. Intermediate liquor fresh material પર reuse થાય છે. Richest miscella descending-side collector માંથી તથા spent meal ascending top પરથી enclosed solvent recovery તરફ જાય છે. સમગ્ર machine ને purely countercurrent ન કહો; બે runs જુદી છે.

ઉપયોગો

Suitable prepared vegetable seeds નું continuous solvent extraction.

Limitations તથા Precautions

Bucket drainage, chain maintenance, fines, liquid segregation તથા solvent containment મહત્વનાં છે.

Reference: [2] Bollman partially countercurrent bucket arrangement.

h.en: Single-stage recovery of salt from sand–salt mixture

body.en:
Objective and official scope

Measure salt recovery using water and a known sand–salt feed. Keep overflow and wet underflow separate for balance.

Apparatus and preparation

Balance, approved mixing/filtering or settling setup, water, known feed composition and validated salt assay such as a calibrated conductivity or approved gravimetric method.

Principle and assumptions

Salt dissolves while sand remains insoluble. Wet underflow includes sand plus retained salt solution; complete dissolution and equal solution composition are ideal assumptions to check.

Procedure and record

Measure actual initial sand/salt/water masses, contact by the supervised method, separate liquor and record liquor/wet-cake masses and solution concentration. Calculate recovered salt and salt remaining with the wet solid. Use known insoluble-sand mass to estimate retained solution if there is no sand loss; drying unwashed cake does not leave pure sand, so wet-minus-dry is not automatically total retained solution.

Calculation format

Safety, quality and limitations

Avoid dust, spills and hot-glass handling; use approved drying/assay equipment and actual measurements. Account for sampling, solid losses and undissolved salt instead of forcing ideal closure.

q.en: Define and explain the principle of Leaching and industrial applications.
q.gu: Leaching તથા Industrial Applications ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા principle સમજાવો.

a.en: Leaching removes a soluble constituent from a solid by contact with a liquid solvent. The remaining solid carrier is substantially insoluble under the chosen conditions. Solvent reaches the solute, dissolution occurs and dissolved material moves from internal pores to the bulk liquid. Examples include oil extraction from vegetable seeds, sugar recovery from prepared plant material and suitable hydrometallurgical recovery. The liquid product is leach liquor; in oil extraction it is often called miscella. Residual solids may retain valuable solution and therefore need washing. Leaching is different from liquid–liquid extraction because the feed contains an insoluble solid framework. Rate can be limited by access, dissolution, internal diffusion or external film transfer; not every delay is solved by stronger agitation.
a.gu: Liquid solvent વડે solid માંનો soluble constituent દૂર કરવો એટલે leaching. Chosen conditions પર બાકી solid carrier substantially insoluble રહે છે. Solvent solute સુધી પહોંચે છે, dissolution થાય છે અને dissolved material internal pores માંથી bulk liquid માં આવે છે. Vegetable seeds માંથી oil, prepared plant material માંથી sugar તથા suitable hydrometallurgical recovery examples છે. Liquid product leach liquor તથા oil extraction માં miscella કહેવાય છે. Residual solids solution retain કરતાં હોવાથી washing જરૂરી છે. LLE કરતાં ફરક insoluble solid framework છે. Access, dissolution, internal diffusion અથવા external film rate limit કરી શકે છે; દરેક delay નું solution વધારે agitation નથી.

q.en: Define and explain the principle of Preparation of solids for leaching.
q.gu: Leaching માટે Solids ની Preparation ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા principle સમજાવો.

a.en: Solid preparation modifies size, structure and accessibility so solvent can contact the soluble material effectively. Crushing or grinding increases exposed area and shortens internal diffusion paths; seed flaking opens cells while retaining useful permeability. Screening can remove excessive fines and produce a more uniform bed. Appropriate pretreatment may release trapped solute, but it must not destroy the desired product or generate unwanted soluble impurities. Excessively fine material can compact, block percolation, make filtration difficult and increase entrainment. Choose particle size according to the contactor: an agitated slurry tolerates a different size distribution from a heap or fixed-bed percolator. Preparation also includes representative feed sampling and documenting initial solute/moisture when a recovery balance is required.
a.gu: Solvent soluble material ને effectively contact કરી શકે તે માટે size, structure તથા accessibility બદલવી એટલે solid preparation. Crushing/grinding થી exposed area વધે તથા internal diffusion path ઘટે છે. Seed flaking cells ખોલીને useful permeability જાળવે છે. Screening excessive fines દૂર કરીને uniform bed આપે છે. Pretreatment trapped solute release કરી શકે છે, પણ desired product ન બગડે તથા unwanted soluble impurities ન બને. Excessive fines compaction, blocked percolation, difficult filtration તથા entrainment કરે છે. Heap/fixed bed અને agitated slurry માટે particle-size distribution જુદી પસંદ થાય છે. Recovery balance માટે feed sampling તથા initial solute/moisture નોંધો.

q.en: Define and explain the principle of Temperature of leaching.
q.gu: Leaching નું Temperature ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા principle સમજાવો.

a.en: Leaching temperature is a selected operating condition affecting solubility, diffusion, viscosity and product/solvent stability. Higher temperature often increases dissolution rate and diffusivity and reduces liquid viscosity, but solubility does not universally rise with temperature. Consider actual solubility data, heat sensitivity, undesired reactions, corrosion, solvent vapor pressure and energy cost. Boiling or evaporation changes solvent inventory and can invalidate a simple material balance. Volatile/flammable solvents require the approved closed system and temperature controls; an educational diagram does not authorize heating or pressurization. Select a temperature giving sufficient rate and recovery without degrading the product or exceeding equipment limits.
a.gu: Solubility, diffusion, viscosity તથા product/solvent stability ને અસર કરતી selected operating condition leaching temperature છે. Temperature વધતાં dissolution rate/diffusivity ઘણીવાર વધે તથા viscosity ઘટે છે, પણ solubility હંમેશાં વધતી નથી. Actual solubility, heat sensitivity, unwanted reactions, corrosion, vapor pressure તથા energy જુઓ. Evaporation solvent inventory બદલી balance invalid કરી શકે છે. Volatile/flammable solvent માટે approved closed system/controls જોઈએ. Study diagram heating/pressurization ની permission નથી. Product તથા equipment limits જાળવી પૂરતો rate/recovery આપતું temperature પસંદ કરો.

q.en: Define and explain the principle of Classification:unsteady and steady leaching.
q.gu: Classification:Unsteady તથા Steady Leaching ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા principle સમજાવો.

a.en: Unsteady leaching changes a batch or bed inventory/composition with time. Steady continuous leaching has approximately constant stream conditions without time accumulation in the chosen control volume. Unsteady operations in the syllabus are in-place, heap, Shanks-system and closed-vessel percolation. Steady operations include leaching during grinding, Dorr agitation, continuous countercurrent decantation, Rotocel and Bollman extraction. A fixed heap can deliver liquor continuously while the solid bed is still being depleted unsteadily; continuous liquid withdrawal alone does not prove steady solids operation. The PDF wording “Door Agitator” is interpreted as the standard Dorr agitator. The individual construction/working cards follow this classification.
a.gu: Unsteady leaching માં batch/bed inventory-composition time સાથે બદલાય છે. Steady continuous leaching માં selected control volume ના stream conditions આશરે constant તથા time accumulation zero છે. Syllabus ના unsteady operations in-place, heap, Shanks તથા closed-vessel percolation છે. Steady operations leaching during grinding, Dorr agitation, CCD, Rotocel તથા Bollman છે. Fixed heap માં liquor continuously નીકળે છતાં solid bed time સાથે deplete થઈ unsteady હોઈ શકે છે. ફક્ત continuous liquid outlet થી steady solids operation સાબિત થતું નથી. PDF નું “Door Agitator” standard Dorr agitator તરીકે સમજ્યું છે. નીચે classification મુજબ Construction/Working cards છે.

q.en: Define and explain the principle of In-place (in-situ) leaching.
q.gu: In-place / In-situ Leaching ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા principle સમજાવો.

a.en: Removal of soluble material from a permeable deposit without first excavating the entire solid mass. A compatible leach liquid percolates through the deposit and dissolves accessible solute for controlled collection.
a.gu: સંપૂર્ણ solid mass excavate કર્યા વગર permeable deposit માંથી soluble material દૂર કરવાની operation છે. Compatible leach liquid deposit માંથી percolate થઈ accessible solute dissolve કરે છે અને controlled collection થાય છે.

q.en: Define and explain the principle of Heap leaching.
q.gu: Heap Leaching ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા principle સમજાવો.

a.en: Leaching a prepared pile of solid on an engineered collection pad by distributed solvent percolation. Liquid flows through voids, dissolves solute and drains as enriched liquor.
a.gu: Engineered collection pad પર prepared solid pile માં distributed solvent percolation થી leaching કરવું. Void spaces માંથી liquid પસાર થઈ solute dissolve કરે છે અને enriched liquor drain થાય છે.

q.en: Define and explain the principle of Shanks-system leaching battery.
q.gu: Shanks-system Leaching Battery ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા principle સમજાવો.

a.en: A valve-switched battery of batch leaching vessels arranged to approximate countercurrent washing. Fresh solvent contacts the most exhausted solids; progressively richer liquor contacts progressively fresher solids.
a.gu: Countercurrent washing approximate કરવા valve-switched batch leaching vessels ની battery છે. Fresh solvent સૌથી exhausted solids ને અને progressively rich liquor progressively fresh solids ને contact કરે છે.

q.en: Define and explain the principle of Percolation in a closed vessel.
q.gu: Closed-vessel Percolation ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા principle સમજાવો.

a.en: Batch solid-bed leaching in an enclosed vessel allowing controlled liquid distribution and liquor collection. Solvent passes through a stationary permeable bed and carries dissolved solute through the support/drain.
a.gu: Controlled liquid distribution તથા collection માટે enclosed vessel માં batch solid-bed leaching. Solvent stationary permeable bed માંથી પસાર થઈ dissolved solute support/drain મારફતે લઈ જાય છે.

q.en: Define and explain the principle of Leaching during grinding.
q.gu: Grinding દરમિયાન Leaching ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા principle સમજાવો.

a.en: Simultaneous wet size reduction and dissolution of accessible solute in a suitable grinding contactor. Grinding exposes fresh surfaces and shortens diffusion paths while liquid removes dissolved material.
a.gu: Suitable grinding contactor માં wet size reduction સાથે accessible solute નું dissolution કરવું. Grinding fresh surfaces expose કરે છે તથા diffusion paths ઘટાડે છે; liquid dissolved material દૂર કરે છે.

q.en: Define and explain the principle of Dorr agitator.
q.gu: Dorr Agitator ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા principle સમજાવો.

a.en: A slurry-leaching agitator combining mechanical rake action with circulation associated with an air-lift arrangement in the classical form. Circulation and suspension improve solvent–solid contact and reduce external film limitations without replacing adequate dissolution time.
a.gu: Classical form માં mechanical rake તથા air-lift circulation જોડતો slurry-leaching agitator છે. Circulation/suspension solvent–solid contact સુધારે છે તથા external film resistance ઘટાડે છે; પૂરતો dissolution time હજુ જોઈએ.

q.en: Define and explain the principle of Continuous countercurrent decantation (CCD).
q.gu: Continuous Countercurrent Decantation (CCD) ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા principle સમજાવો.

a.en: A series of thickeners/wash stages moving solid-rich underflow forward while wash liquor progresses oppositely. Repeated dilution, mixing and gravity separation wash soluble material from retained solution with countercurrent use of fresh liquid.
a.gu: Thickeners/wash stages ની series જેમાં solid-rich underflow આગળ તથા wash liquor opposite direction માં જાય છે. Repeated dilution, mixing તથા gravity separation થી retained solution નું soluble material countercurrent fresh wash વડે recover થાય છે.

q.en: Define and explain the principle of Rotocel (Rotocell) extractor.
q.gu: Rotocel / Rotocell Extractor ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા principle સમજાવો.

a.en: A continuous vegetable-seed extractor using slowly rotating compartments over a drainage arrangement. Solvent percolation and staged miscella reuse contact prepared seeds in an approximately countercurrent progression.
a.gu: Drainage arrangement ઉપર slowly rotating compartments ધરાવતો continuous vegetable-seed extractor છે. Solvent percolation તથા staged miscella reuse થી prepared seeds સાથે approximately countercurrent progression બને છે.

q.en: Define and explain the principle of Bollman extractor.
q.gu: Bollman Extractor ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા principle સમજાવો.

a.en: A continuous vertical extractor carrying prepared solids in perforated buckets on an endless chain. Two bucket runs combine contact with recycled miscella and fresh solvent, including a countercurrent washing run.
a.gu: Endless chain ના perforated buckets માં prepared solids લઈ જતો continuous vertical extractor છે. બે bucket runs recycled miscella તથા fresh solvent contact આપે છે; એક run countercurrent washing કરે છે.
